text: Centre frame: a white translucent plastic squeeze/wash bottle standing upright on a white platform, fitted with a red angled cap/spout that is closed, and a blue band around the bottle's midsection. The bottle appears to hold a clear or colourless liquid; contents are not clearly visible through the opaque plastic. Behind the bottle is a white robotic arm segment with a black cable looping over the bottle's cap area, and a small white label or tag at the bottle's right side. The platform sits on an aluminium extrusion rail/linear track running diagonally from lower left to upper right, with metal bolts and a round white disc mounted in front of the bottle. A second empty white mounting disc lies at lower centre. Right side: dark grey panelled surface. Upper left: pale grey benchtop with white trays and an instrument.
